name: weekly
description: 科技爱好者周刊，每周五发布
one_liner: A long-running Chinese-language tech newsletter, published every Friday and archived here as plain text files, covering interesting software, articles, and industry news.
buyer: Not really a buyer situation: it's a personal newsletter archive, not a product. At most, a Chinese-reading tech audience who follows it for free curated links.
business_use_cases: A reader mines back issues for story and product ideas to write about in their own newsletter.
A translator republishes selected issues in English for a non-Chinese-reading tech audience.
An aggregator includes it as one of several sources for a weekly 'best of tech reads' digest.

money_ideas.idea: Curate and translate select issues into an English digest and monetize via a paid tier for non-Chinese readers.

steal_this: Honestly, this is a personal content archive, not a business opportunity. The one legitimate weekend project is a translated-highlights newsletter for an English-speaking audience, credited to the original author.
